Improvement Engineer
Burscough
Monday - Friday (40 hours per week)
£57,500
As a Improvement Engineer you will play a key role in improving the reliability, performance and efficiency of our production assets. Working within the Conversion area, you will use your technical expertise and problem-solving skills to identify recurring issues, reduce downtime and deliver sustainable improvements.
You will be responsible for the maintenance and optimisation of high-speed finishing equipment downstream from the corrugator, including Flexo Folder Gluers (FFGs), Rotary Die Cutters and Flatbed Die Cutters. Your focus will be on keeping equipment running safely and efficiently while ensuring the accuracy, quality and consistency of finished products.
Working closely with Production and Maintenance teams, you will help identify chronic losses, resolve recurring equipment issues and deliver improvements that increase uptime and reduce waste.
The salary package includes compensation for undertaking up to 20 night and weekend holiday cover shifts annually. Any holiday cover hours worked in excess of the employee's standard weekly contracted hours will be paid at the applicable overtime rate.
Your responsibilities will include
• Delivering planned, preventative and corrective maintenance across the Conversion area.
• Acting as the technical subject matter expert for your assigned assets and equipment.
• Diagnosing and resolving mechanical, electrical, pneumatic and automation faults quickly and effectively.
• Maintaining and troubleshooting high-speed converting equipment from manufacturers such as Bobst, Martin/FFG, Tanabe, Gopfert and Sun Automation.
• Calibrating and maintaining print cylinders, registration systems, anilox rolls, doctor blade assemblies and rotary die-cutting cylinders to ensure precise product quality.
• Maintaining high-speed feed systems, vacuum transfer tables, folder-gluer belts and associated equipment to minimise jams and production stoppages.
• Maintaining, flushing and calibrating automated hot-melt and cold-glue systems and associated inspection sensors.
• Troubleshooting multi-axis servo drives, encoders, PLCs and automated control systems responsible for machine timing and synchronisation.
• Supporting quick changeovers by improving machine setup, recipes and adjustment processes to minimise downtime between product changes.
• Identifying and eliminating chronic equipment losses and recurring failures.
• Supporting root-cause analysis and implementing sustainable corrective actions.
• Reviewing and optimising maintenance routines to improve equipment reliability and performance.
• Working closely with Production colleagues to build strong relationships and minimise disruption to manufacturing.
• Accurately recording maintenance activity, findings, spare parts and corrective actions within the CMMS.
• Supporting continuous improvement, Maintenance Excellence and reliability-focused projects.
• Ensuring all maintenance activities are carried out safely and in line with site procedures and engineering standards.
Person Specification
We are looking for a technically skilled and proactive engineering professional who enjoys working with complex, high-speed machinery and solving problems in a fast-paced production environment.
You will ideally have:
• A recognised engineering qualification such as an apprenticeship, NVQ Level 3/4 or equivalent in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics or Maintenance Engineering.
• Experience maintaining high-speed converting, printing, packaging or similar multi-station production machinery.
• Strong mechanical and electrical engineering skills, with experience of servo motors, precision gearboxes, pneumatic actuators and electronic sensors.
• Experience troubleshooting automated machinery involving multiple axes, drives, PLCs and machine-control systems.
• The ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, pneumatic diagrams and mechanical drawings.
• Experience with precision mechanical adjustment and alignment, using tools such as dial indicators, calipers and gauges.
• An understanding of machine timing, synchronisation and registration within high-speed production equipment.
• Experience working with industrial networks such as EtherNet/IP or Profibus would be advantageous.
• Experience with PLCs and HMI systems, with Siemens, Rockwell/Allen-Bradley or similar platforms desirable.
• Experience maintaining or troubleshooting automated strapping, bundling or palletising equipment would be beneficial.
• Experience using a CMMS to manage preventative maintenance, work orders and spare parts.
• A strong focus on safety, quality and continuous improvement.
• A proactive approach to problem-solving, with the ability to identify the root cause of issues rather than simply fixing the immediate problem.
• The ability to work effectively with both Maintenance and Production teams.
This is an opportunity to use your engineering expertise to make a real difference to the performance of our Conversion operation. You will play a key role in reducing downtime, improving machine reliability and ensuring our high-speed finishing equipment delivers the quality and output our customers expect.

About The Role
Are you looking to build your career with one of the UK's leading property consultancies?
We're seeking a Graduate Building Surveyor to join our established Building Consultancy team, working alongside experienced Chartered Surveyors across a diverse range of commercial property instructions. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience from day one, develop your technical knowledge, and work directly with clients across a wide variety of projects and sectors.
You'll work on live instructions across office, industrial, retail, healthcare, leisure and PRS assets, gaining exposure to both project and professional work while receiving structured support towards your APC and MRICS qualification.
The Role
As a Graduate Building Surveyor, you'll assist with and undertake a broad range of building surveying instructions, including:
• Project management and contract administration
• Dilapidations advice and negotiations
• Landlord and tenant matters
• Pre-acquisition surveys
• Technical due diligence
• Schedules of Condition
• Defect analysis and building pathology
• Reinstatement Cost Assessments
• Preparation of specifications and technical reports

• Client liaison and stakeholder management

• Degree qualified in Building Surveying or a related discipline
• Ambition to become MRICS qualified
• Strong communication and relationship-building skills
• Commercial awareness and a proactive approach
• Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines
• Professional and client-focused mindset
• Team player with a collaborative attitude
• Experience with AutoCAD, Microsoft Project and NBS Specification Writer would be advantageous but is not essential.
About the Team
You'll join a highly experienced team of Chartered Surveyors working across a broad range of sectors and services. We pride ourselves on providing graduates with genuine responsibility, exposure to high-profile projects and the support needed to develop into successful Building Surveyors.
Alongside technical development, you'll be encouraged to contribute to business development activities, attend industry events and build your profile within the market.
This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious graduate to launch their career within a leading Building Consultancy team and gain exposure to a varied portfolio of projects and clients from the outset.
For more details on our UK Building & Project Consultancy team, please click here.
Competitive salary

Job Title
Credit Operations Lead
Job Description
Credit Operations Lead
So, who are we?
IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.
The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next.
Join us at IG – the future gets built here.
Your role in the Team's Success
As Credit Operations Lead, you will be responsible for the day-to-day leadership of the Credit Operations team, ensuring the group's credit risk, margin, client categorisation and debt management activities are delivered accurately, on time and in line with regulatory requirements. You will set the standard for operational control within the team, act as the escalation point for complex client and credit matters, and drive continuous improvement across our processes and controls. Reporting to the Head of Client Operations, you will play a key role in protecting both our clients and the group while helping shape how the function operates as the business grows.
What you'll do
Your responsibilities include:
• Lead, coach and develop the Credit Operations team, setting clear objectives, managing performance and ensuring the team meets its individual and collective KPIs
• Oversee the management of client margin calls, account settlements and close-out activity, ensuring decisions are timely, consistent and well documented
• Own the monitoring and management of client credit exposure, including the assessment, approval and periodic review of credit facilities and limits within delegated authority
• Oversee the retail to professional client classification process, ensuring assessments are robust, evidenced and compliant with FCA requirements and internal policy
• Manage the end-to-end debt management and recovery process, including client engagement, repayment arrangements, escalation to third parties and write-off recommendations
• Own and maintain the first line risk controls for the team, covering risk monitoring, risk identification and risk analysis, and ensure issues and breaches are identified, recorded and remediated promptly
• Act as the senior escalation point for complex client queries and complaints relating to credit, margin and account status, ensuring good client outcomes in line with Consumer Duty
• Oversee the production and distribution of daily, weekly and monthly management information, reports and audits, and present key insights and trends to senior stakeholders
• Lead the team's response to internal audit, compliance monitoring, external audit and regulatory requests, ensuring evidence is accurate and actions are closed within agreed timescales
• Maintain up-to-date procedures and process documentation, ensuring the team operates to documented and controlled standards
• Build strong working relationships with stakeholders across the business, including Compliance, Risk, Finance, Dealing, Legal and Account Management
• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, automation and control, and work with product owners and technology teams to deliver change and enhance our client offering
What you'll need :
Key requirements:
• Proven experience in a credit operations, credit risk, margin or client operations role within financial services, ideally in a leveraged trading, brokerage or investment environment
• Experience of leading, managing or supervising a team, with a track record of developing people and delivering through others
• Sound understanding of margin and credit risk concepts, and working knowledge of the FCA regulatory framework, including client categorisat
• ion and Consumer Duty
• Strong control mindset, with experience of operating and evidencing first line controls and supporting audit or regulatory reviews
• Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the confidence to handle difficult client conversations and challenge stakeholders constructively
• Strong analytical ability and attention to detail, with the ability to interpret data and turn it into clear recommendations
• Ability to work well under pressure, make sound decisions in fast-moving markets and prioritise effectively across competing demands
• Self-motivated, organised and comfortable taking ownership of outcomes
Desirable:
• Degree level education, or a relevant professional qualification such as the CISI Investment Operations Certificate or equivalent
• Experience of debt recovery or collections processes
• Experience of process improvement, automation or change delivery within an operations function
• Proficiency in Excel and familiarity with data or reporting tools
The perks
It really is more than a job. We’ll recognise your talent and make sure that you can still have a life – at work, and outside of it. Networks, committees, awards, sports and social clubs, mentorships, volunteering opportunities, extra time off… the list goes on.
• Competitive salary
• Flexible Benefits Package on top of your salary (12%)
• Private medical cover for you and your family
• Life insurance
• Contribution to gym memberships
• 25 Days holiday, with 1 additional day off to celebrate your Birthday & 2 additional days off a year for voluntary work (28 in total)
• The option to buy or sell holiday days
• Unlimited access to the LinkedIn Learning Platform
• A comprehensive global and local onboarding process
• Employee-led LGBTQ+, Women’s, Black and Parents & Carers networks with an annual budget for organising events & projects that foster an open, diverse and inclusive culture
• Option to participate and create ESG initiatives based on IG Brighter Future Fund
• Enhanced primary (maternity), secondary (paternity), and shared parental pay and leave, as well as a range of support and benefits for parents

The Company
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards.  Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day.  We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Real stakeholder visibility. You'll regularly engage with senior finance leaders and business partners globally. That kind of cross-functional, international exposure builds commercial acumen and communication skills that go far beyond technical tax knowledge.
Flexible, hybrid working from our modern office in Chester. A. With the 50% hybrid-working model, you’ll get to collaborate and build supportive working relationships with the large tax team, as well as others in the ECC, whilst creating a healthy work-life balance.
The BMS mission as your backdrop. When you're filing that return, managing that audit, or navigating a piece of new legislation — you're doing it in support of a company that is genuinely working to help patients with serious diseases. That context changes how the work feels.

• Strategic planning and decision support – modelling to support ongoing business planning and to quantify the impact of strategic and routine decisions on a company’s results
• Restructuring and insolvency – turnaround planning to rebuild lender confidence, short-term cash flow forecasting, and insolvency outcome analysis
• Funds and valuations – asset and fund models to support initial transactions and ongoing valuation and reporting requirements, with a particular focus on the infrastructure sector
Financial models underpin almost all business decisions and all corporate transactions. We build, review and amend models across all sectors, and our tools and analysis help our clients understand the impact of their decisions before they make them. Our priority is delivering tools that are easy to understand, as well as flexible and robust in the face of change. Most of our work is executed in Microsoft Excel, with some use of other programming languages. We work as part of the firm's wider modelling community, sharing knowledge and best practice with other modelling experts.
The Associate Directors in the team are responsible for leading the delivery of modelling assignments, and for executing work of the most complex nature. You will work closely with clients, supporting the partners, directors and other Advisory teams to plan and lead modelling assignments, and play a role in organising and developing the team and its pipeline of business. This rare opportunity presents great scope to develop yourself and your career as the team grows.

• Proactively contribute to the team’s marketing efforts, including attending networking events, preparing presentations and marketing collateral

• Provide coaching and training to junior team members
• Contribute to the operational and interpersonal success of the team
Knowing you’re right for us

• Logical approach to problem-solving, attention to detail

It would be great if you had some of the following skills, but don’t worry if you don’t tick every box, we’ll help you develop along the way.

Knowing we’re right for you

Beyond the job

Job Title
Senior Product Manager - OTC Trading
Job Description
Location: London, UK (Hybrid: 3 days in office)
Employment type: Permanent, full time
So, who are we?
IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.
The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next.
Join us at IG – the future gets built here.
Your Team:
This role sits within the Trading & Investments domain of the Product function, reporting into the Head of Product, Trading & Investments. The domain’s mission is to give every client the tools to trade, from first investment to multi-asset portfolio. You will use AI tools and work closely with engineering, design, dealing, compliance, legal, and marketing to define and deliver the OTC trading proposition and help expand it to other markets. The team operates at the intersection of product craft and commercial ambition, focused on building trading experiences that feel effortless for IG’s customers while keeping them safe, informed and in control.
Your role in the Team’s Success:
This is a role for a Senior PM who is as comfortable defining the strategy as they are shipping against it. As Senior Product Manager for OTC Trading, you will own the product vision and multi-quarter roadmap for IG’s leveraged derivatives offering: spread bets, CFDs, options and futures. You will determine which problems are worth solving, set direction, and drive execution end to end. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, navigate ambiguity, and make decisions that directly shape commercial outcomes. You will not be handed a brief. You will write it.
IG is moving towards a single, modern trading platform across its markets. This is a chance to shape what OTC trading looks like on that platform: rapid, reliable, secure and intuitive, for clients ranging from first-time derivatives traders to experienced professionals.
What you’ll do:
Product strategy and roadmap
• Own the product vision and multi-quarter roadmap for OTC trading, aligned to IG’s commercial objectives. You will set that roadmap, not just contribute to it.
• Determine which problems are worth solving and why, before any solution work begins.
• Make strategic build vs buy vs partner decisions grounded in customer needs, commercial viability, and technical feasibility.
• Drive competitive intelligence and translate market insights into differentiated propositions across spread betting, CFDs, options and futures.
• Shape how the OTC proposition converges onto a single global platform, balancing local market needs with a consistent client experience.
Discovery and delivery
• Run discovery that goes beyond what customers say. Understand the motivations, friction points, and habits that drive or block trading behaviour.
• Use AI tools actively across your workflow: synthesising research, generating prototypes, accelerating delivery, and surfacing insights faster.
• Partner with engineering and design to scope, prioritise, and ship with quality and pace.
• Define success metrics and iterate relentlessly based on evidence.
Cross-functional leadership
• Influence stakeholders across product, engineering, dealing, legal, compliance, marketing, and senior leadership. You drive alignment up, down, and across the organisation.
• Work closely with Peer Product Managers leading the adjacent areas, as well as coordinate with teams across Core technology to help build scalable backend systems.
• Navigate regulatory requirements (including product governance and Consumer Duty) and translate compliance constraints into seamless customer experiences, including how risk, margin and leverage are presented to clients.
• Work comfortably with APIs, pricing and execution infrastructure, and platform integrations.
• Identify opportunities to optimise and present pricing it in ways that helps customers and business.
• Mentor and raise the bar for PMs around you.
What You'll Need:
• Five or more years shipping consumer-facing products in trading platforms, investment platforms, neobanks, fintech, or adjacent consumer financial services.
• Proven ability to own and drive product strategy. That means vision setting and direction, not just roadmap input.
• Deep curiosity about trader and investor behaviour. You understand what makes people start trading, stop, switch, or stay.
• AI-native working style: you already use AI tools (LLMs, prototyping tools, research synthesis, workflow automation) to move faster and think better.
• Comfortable with ambiguity. You can define the problem when the brief doesn’t exist yet.
• Obsession with customer experience. You sweat the details that make journeys feel effortless, including in complex, real-time trading interfaces.
• Regulatory intuition. You can navigate compliance without it becoming a blocker to great UX, and you are comfortable working in a heavily regulated, risk-sensitive product area.
• Evidence and data-driven. You define metrics, run experiments, and make calls based on what works.
• Strong stakeholder management. You influence without authority and drive alignment across complex organisations.
Desirable
• Direct experience with leveraged or derivative products (CFDs, spread betting, options, futures, FX) or active trading platforms.
• Experience building or launching AI-powered features in a consumer product.
• Worked on platform partnerships, broker integrations, or exchange infrastructure.
• Built products that serve both novice investors and sophisticated traders.
• Experience in fintech, financial services, or a similarly regulated industry.
• Exposure to multi-market or multi-regulator product environments.
The perks
It really is more than a job. We think like a start-up, but we deliver like a FTSE 100 — so the bar is high, and we won't pretend otherwise. We work hybrid, which means three days in the office. We’ll recognise your talent and make sure that you can still have a life – at work, and outside of it. Networks, committees, awards, sports and social clubs, mentorships, volunteering opportunities, extra time off… the list goes on.
• Competitive salary
• Flexible Benefits Package on top of your salary (12%)
• Private medical cover for you and your family
• Life insurance
• Contribution to gym memberships
• 25 Days holiday, with 1 additional day off to celebrate your Birthday & 2 additional days off a year for voluntary work (28 in total)
• The option to buy or sell holiday days
• A comprehensive global and local onboarding process
• Enhanced primary (maternity), secondary (paternity), and shared parental pay…
